resources.string: BeStrong was born on Forocoches and grows with the ideas of the people who use it. You can improve it too: free, no account, in a minute.
Suggest your idea: what you would improve and how you picture it.
Suggestions are reviewed every day. If something is missing, we ask you right here.
Good ideas get built and arrive in an upcoming version.
Follow how yours is going in “My suggestions”.
BeStrong was born on Forocoches and you make it better. In Profile › Community you can suggest an idea in a minute, no account needed, and the good ones arrive in upcoming versions.

• New, cleaner design in light and dark • Settings grouped by topic, each on its own screen • New “Permissions and connections” screen: turn everything on in one tap • Community in Profile: suggest improvements, follow the replies and read news from the team • Cardio timer and exercise switching from the watch
